properties.site-address: Former Birchwood Primary School, Russett Way, Swanley
properties.notes: The site is located adjacent to Swanley urban confines. The existing access onto Russett Way could be utilised. A new access could also be made onto Leydenhatch Lane. The playing fields are identified in the Open Spaces Study as an outdoor sports facility which forms an important part of the green infrastructure network. The loss of this use is not supported and would need to be clearly demonstrated. Overall the previously developed part of the site is considered able to accommodate development however it is located in the Green Belt so this designation would need to change in order for it to be developed.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
